read_ply_file: read a PLY file from a path or stream using PlyData.read and access element data
write_ply_file: write PLY data to a file by creating PlyData with PlyElement.describe and calling write
describe_ply_element: construct a PlyElement from a numpy structured array using PlyElement.describe for writing PLY files
make2d_array: convert an array of arrays into a 2D numpy array using the make2d helper function
parse_ply_header: parse a PLY file header from a stream using PlyData._parse_header to inspect format and elements
